steps: 1. Hiring manager uploads the voice note; the requisition agent writes the job description and rubric; wording is checked; the hiring manager approves and publishes
2. 52 candidates apply (PDF, Word, scans, screenshots); the document agent reads each CV; identity is hidden; unsure fields go to the review queue
3. The recruiter checks 8 scanned CVs against the originals and confirms the fields
4. The screening agent scores every candidate 0-3 on every skill with an exact CV quote; the compliance reviewer checks every quote; a shortlist is suggested
5. The recruiter approves the shortlist: the top 5 plus 2 added to follow the recorded interviews (a person decides)
6. The recruiter invites the shortlist to the AI interview and approves the invitations in the outbox; one candidate asks for a person instead
7. AI interviews run from recorded answers (spoken questions, diagrams, follow-ups); each answer is scored with a quote; the recruiter reviews every scorecard
8. Second round: the recruiter moves four candidates to a human interview; the copilot follows each recording live; the recruiter scores
9. The recruiter decides on each interviewed candidate, with a reason; the decision emails are drafted and approved
10. A candidate who was not shortlisted asks why; an explanation is drafted from the evidence; the recruiter reviews and approves it
11. Final checks: the compliance reviewer re-checks everything; the decision log is checked for any decision, message or move without a person
